entities.summary: Selwyn Francis Edge (1868–1940) was a British businessman, racing driver, cyclist and record-breaker. He is principally associated with selling and racing De Dion-Bouton, Gladiator; Clemént-Panhard, Napier and AC cars. Selwyn Edge was a performers & entertainers from Sydney (1868-03-29, Sydney–1940-02-12). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
